---
name: OOVS requirement proposal
about: Propose a testable requirement or change to the core standard
title: "OOVS-: "
labels: ["requirement", "needs-triage"]
---

## Decision problem

What failure, harm, or assurance gap does this address?

## Proposed requirement

Use MUST / SHOULD / MAY. Keep it testable.

## Verification method

What records or tests demonstrate implementation?

## Evidence and limitations

Link stable sources. State context, limitations, and conflicts of interest.

## Safety and rights screen

- [ ] No personal, case, victim, or operational data is included.
- [ ] This does not enable unlawful access, stalking, doxxing, evasion, or coercion.
- [ ] High-risk implications (if any) are described.
- [ ] A privacy/safeguarding/rights reviewer is requested if required.
